In a द्वन्द्व compound, let a what begins with a vowel and ends with a short अ be placed first.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द्व-घि

The word अजर्यंम्‌ 'imperishable' is irregularly formed when qualifying the word संगतम्‌ 'friendship' expressed or understood.

Terms: Irregular

The affix टाप् is used to indicate feminine nature after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) अज etc. and after the stems ending in short अ।

Terms: विभक्ति-F

The affix थ्यन् comes in the sense of 'good for that' after the words अज and अवि।

Terms:

The two affixes beginning with a vowel i.e. ईयस् and इष्ठ are added only after words denoting attributes.

Terms: ईयस् and इष्ठ

Of that whose first syllable begins with a vowel, there are two in the room of the second portion containing a single vowel.

Terms: लिट् लकार

After a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अ or आ the affix अस्of the Nominative 1st-Case plural gets, in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the augment अस् (असुक्) at the end.

Terms: छन्दस् substitution
